content.clinical_guideline: 2020 ACC/AHA Guidelines for the Management of Patients with Valvular Heart Disease.

sections.title: Management of CAD in Patients Undergoing TAVI
sections.content: Coronary risk factors and management strategies are critical in patients undergoing TAVI to ensure successful outcomes.

sections.title: Management of CAD in Patients Undergoing SAVR
sections.content: Coronary anatomy should be assessed in patients undergoing SAVR to identify and manage any coronary artery disease.
